update.name: EnergyMeter + FrenzyOverlay Components
update.context: EnergyMeter renders in the EnergyBar zone (48px, full width, below TopBar). FrenzyOverlay renders over the grid during FRENZY mode. Both consume EnergyState from useEnergy hook. Visual direction: actual 3D modern. Real depth, lighting, physical feel. All animations via motion/react (NOT framer-motion). Pure ASCII characters only — no emoji in source files (Termux arm64/esbuild constraint).

dependencies.dep: update-39 complete — useEnergy.ts and EnergyState exist

constraints.constraint: No emoji characters in source. Use text labels only.
motion/react for all animations — not framer-motion.
Pure ASCII source file — no box-drawing or special characters.
pointer-events: none on the entire overlay — never blocks input.

do-not.rule: Do not use framer-motion — use motion/react.
Do not add pointer-events to overlay — it must be none.
Do not use emoji characters in source files.
Do not use Math.random() for visual effects.
Do not import from apps/server or packages/engine — UI only.

verification.check: FrenzyOverlay does not block pointer events on grid tiles
EnergyMeter renders correctly at energy=0, energy=150, energy=300
Instability state visually distinct from normal FRENZY state
No framer-motion import present in either file
